tagline: The adventure capital of the world — birthplace of bungee, ringed by The Remarkables and the blue fjord-country lake.
overview: Queenstown is scenery so extreme it looks rendered — The Remarkables' serrated range rises straight out of Lake Wakatipu's cold blue water, and the little resort town at its base invented the commercial bungee jump.

The adventure menu is absurd: bungy at the original Kawarau Bridge, jet boats through Shotover Canyon, skydives, luge tracks, and four ski fields in winter. The Skyline gondola climbs to the world's most photogenic buffet over the lake.

Speed's 2024 tour streamed from Queenstown — the scenery did half the work. Beyond the thrills, Milford Sound's fjords and Glenorchy's 'Middle-earth' valleys make it the natural base for the South Island's greatest hits.

funFacts.title: BUNGY'S BIRTHPLACE
funFacts.text: AJ Hackett launched the world's first commercial bungee at Kawarau Bridge in 1988.

funFacts.title: THE REMARKABLES
funFacts.text: The jagged range is one of only two ranges worldwide to run exactly north–south.

funFacts.title: ADVENTURE CAPITAL
funFacts.text: Bungy, jet boat, skydive, luge, rafting — the menu is unmatched.

funFacts.title: A FJORD DAY TRIP
funFacts.text: Milford Sound — Rudyard Kipling's 'eighth wonder' — is a day's round trip.

funFacts.title: SKYLINE GONDOLA
funFacts.text: The steepest gondola in the Southern Hemisphere climbs Bob's Peak.

funFacts.title: FOUR SKI FIELDS
funFacts.text: Coronet Peak, The Remarkables, Cardrona and Treble Cone serve the winter.

funFacts.title: MIDDLE-EARTH
funFacts.text: Glenorchy and Paradise nearby filmed as Isengard and Lothlórien country.

funFacts.title: THE FERGBURGER
funFacts.text: The legendary burger joint draws queues around the block at all hours.

funFacts.title: GOLD RUSH TOWN
funFacts.text: The 1862 gold rush built the town — Arrowtown's mining lanes survive.

funFacts.title: A LIVING LAKE
funFacts.text: Wakatipu's water level rises and falls ~20cm on a 26-minute cycle — a Māori legend explains the giant's heartbeat.
